Long Haul

Procedimiento de turbulencia

A set of prescribed actions for flight crew to follow when encountering turbulence, including changes in altitude, speed, and securing the cabin.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Procedimiento de turbulencia?

In this glossary, Procedimiento de turbulencia refers to: A set of prescribed actions for flight crew to follow when encountering turbulence, including changes in altitude, speed, and securing the cabin.

How is Procedimiento de turbulencia used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Inicie el procedimiento de turbulencia y notifique a la tripulación de cabina que asegure la cabina de inmediato."

Why does Procedimiento de turbulencia matter in aviation?

Procedimiento de turbulencia matters because it supports clear communication in Long Haul contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Procedimiento de turbulencia?

Procedimiento de turbulencia is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Procedimiento de turbulencia belong to?

In this glossary, Procedimiento de turbulencia is grouped under Long Haul. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A set of prescribed actions for flight crew to follow when encountering turbulence, including changes in altitude, speed, and securing the cabin.

Operational example

Initiate turbulence procedure and notify cabin crew to secure the cabin immediately.

Localized term

Localized example
